name: RoboDebut
tagline: Submit websites and startups to RoboDebut for manual review.
description: Submit websites and startups to RoboDebut through submit_project after the user authorizes submission. Read submission_instructions for the current rules. Ordinary submissions require a visible followed RoboDebut homepage badge and a private maker contact email. An operator reviews each proposal before publication. RoboDebut is affiliated with LinkBunny.

install.notes: Read https://robodebut.com/llms.txt before submitting. This endpoint uses anonymous, stateless Streamable HTTP. Protocol checks used the official TypeScript SDK 2.4.0; Cline runtime acceptance has not been tested.
